# Amentum Honors the 25th Anniversary of September 11 with a Day of Service


September 15, 2026 •

[Corporate Social Responsibility](https://www.amentum.com/blog_category/corporate-social-responsibility-2/) ,

On the 25th anniversary of September 11, 2001, Amentum proudly joined hands with volunteers across the United States to transform a day of remembrance into action as part of the 9/11 Day of Service.


At the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., Amentum employees and their families, along with members of the executive leadership team, participated in a day dedicated to service, compassion, and community impact. They joined thousands of volunteers nationwide to assemble meal kits aimed at alleviating food insecurity across the country. This effort was part of a larger initiative organized by[911day.org](https://911day.org/) , which works to turn the memory of September 11 into an opportunity to foster unity through service and acts of kindness.


This year’s 9/11 Day of Service rallied volunteers in 50 U.S. cities to pack an incredible 20 million meals for individuals and families in need. For Amentum, the event was more than just a community initiative; it was a way to honor the legacy of the lives lost and forever changed by the events of September 11.


“On the 25th anniversary of September 11th, we honor the memory of those we lost by coming together in the spirit of unity and service,” said CEO John Heller. “At Amentum, we are humbled to join thousands of volunteers from across the nation to pack 20 million meals to support people in our community. This day reminds us that even in the shadow of immense tragedy, our collective resolve can make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.”


For the Amentum team, participating in the 9/11 Day of Service is a testament to the company’s commitment to making a positive, lasting impact in the communities where we live and work. This special day was not only about giving back but also about fostering a shared humanity, a reminder that even in the face of adversity, we can find strength in unity and hope for the future.


Amentum extends heartfelt gratitude to its employees, their families, and all the volunteers who came together to make a difference on this day of remembrance.


Together, they honored those we lost by serving those in need.
